g.text: I want to build a lightweight single-player game I can play in short sessions
and resume anytime. What genre is easy to ship and fun to replay?
How about a node-based maritime expedition called Mistport Expedition? I will own
route settlement and save files, though chapter balance needs a dedicated owner.
to own chapter tables and playtest balance.
Hi all! With 10 starting supply, I simulated two Coast routes—the risky Storm route
gives the same 2 medals as the safe route. Payoff feels low—thoughts?
